Image generation that also returns text is not a conventional Gemini text context window.

## gemini-image-text-output

| Property | Description |
|---|---|
| Model code | `gemini-image-text-output` |
| Supported data types | **Inputs** Text, Image **Output** Images, Text |
| Token limits | **Input token limit** 65,536 **Output token limit** 32,768 |
